BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI

CLASS:   BTECH   SEMESTER : IV
BRANCH:  CHEMICAL ENGG   SESSION : SP/2023

SUBJECT: CL235 SAFETY & HAZARDS IN PROCESS INDUSTRIES
TIME: 02 Hours   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


   CO BL
Q.1(a) Define Hazards? Classify different chemical hazards. [2] CO-1 1Remember
Q.1(b) What are the significance of different colour code in MSDS in terms of extent
of hazards.
[3] CO-1 2Understand


Q.2(a) Classify fire in terms of its source. Write the selection of fire extinguisher on
the basis of fire classes.
[2] CO-2 2Understand
Q.2(b) State  the  power  and  responsibilities  of  Operational  safety  and  health
administration (OSHA).
[3] CO-1 1Remember


Q.3(a) What are the OSHA’s Hazard Communication (HazCom) requirements? [2] CO-3 1Remember
Q.3(b) Define toxicants. What are the responses of toxicants? [3] CO-2 1Remember


Q.4(a) Define  lethal  dose.  Explain  LD50  with  reference  to  response  and  dose
relationship.
[2] CO-1 3Apply
Q.4(b) 20 mg of a narcotic substance under study causes a 250 g rat to sleep for 1
hour. What is this dose rate in mg/kg? what dose would be needed to produce
the same effect on an 70-kg human?
[3] CO-5 4Analyze


Q.5(a) What is threshold limiting value (TLV)? Explain three different types of TLVs
and its utilization.
[2] CO-4 2Understand
Q.5(b) Air  contains  5  ppm  of  diethylamine (TLV-TWA  of  10  ppm),  20  ppm  of
cyclohexanol (TLV-TWA of 50 ppm) and 10 ppm of propylene oxide (TLV-TWA
of 20 ppm). Has the TLV-TWA level been exceeded?
[3] CO-5 4Analyze
